bias.en: Downtrend · lowest close since April, testing the Nov 17 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 收盘创 4月以来新低，测试 11月17日低点

read.en: ASML fell 2.8% on Nov 19 to $1,356.20, trading $1,354.30–1,443.72. It is below the 5-day ($1,407.3), 10-day ($1,451.4), 30-day ($1,562.0), 100-day ($1,687.6) and 200-day ($1,601.9), all now falling, with the 200-day turning lower. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($1,555.08), and RSI is 33.7.

The $1,443.72 high was rejected at the $1,425–1,447.5 band, and the close slipped to the bottom of the $1,351.8–1,368 support, the lowest close since Apr 7; the Nov 17 and Nov 5 lows still held. Resistance is $1,368–1,383, then $1,404–1,411.5 (5-day) and $1,436–1,451 (Nov 16 and 19 highs, 10-day). Support is $1,351.8–1,355, then $1,300 and $1,248–1,276 (March lows). A close below $1,351.8 would target $1,300; above $1,383, $1,404–1,411.
